publisher: NHS Business Services Authority (NHSBSA), on behalf of NHS England
dataset: Finalised Secondary Care Medicines Data (SCMD) with indicative price

acquisition.method: CKAN package_show metadata retrieval; resource bytes are not retained
verification: resource SHA-256 and size from catalogue
acquisition.refresh_rule: Re-fetch package metadata and compare catalogue metadata_modified, resource id, size, and SHA-256 before each use; invalidate downstream receipts on any change.

supports: NHS Trust-level aggregate product/time observations where present
does_not_support: HTA, policy, regulatory, empirical, or calibrated claims

contingencies.inaccessible: retain metadata-only receipt and defer resource use
contingencies.conflicting: compare provisional and finalised releases; prefer finalised release and record divergence
contingencies.incomplete: record missing product/time coverage as a negative receipt; do not infer absence
contingencies.restricted_or_terms_changed: stop acquisition and invalidate dependent receipts
